latest_release.body:
![Terrain3D Logo](/doc/docs/images/terrain3d.jpg)
Cover art by [FR3NKD](https://x.com/FR3NKD)

# Terrain3D v1.1.0

This release brings support for Godot 4.8, C# bindings, an ocean mesh with default shader, texture displacement, AO texture support, better web and mobile support, and over 380 updates.

#### Requirements
* Supports Godot 4.5-4.8+.
* Supports Windows, Linux, macOS and experimental mobile and web platforms. See notes for all [platforms and renderers](https://terrain3d.readthedocs.io/en/1.1/docs/platforms.html).

#### Installation
* Get Terrain3D in the `Asset Store` / `AssetLib` tab within Godot.
* Or download `Terrain3D_v1.1.0-stable.zip` under `Assets` below.
* Follow the [Installation & Upgrade](https://terrain3d.readthedocs.io/en/1.1/docs/installation.html) instructions.

## Games Made With Terrain3D
Check out other [Games Made With Terrain3D](https://terrain3d.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docs/games.html). If you're using Terrain3D in your game, let me know so I can add it.
 
## Highlighted Changes

Note [Changes to the API between 1.0 and 1.1](https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/discussions/756).

Major New Features:
* Improved mobile support (See [Max Regions](https://terrain3d.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docs/performance.html#material) and [Platforms](https://terrain3d.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docs/platforms.html#android))
* Add example particle grass to extras by @Xtarsia in https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/pull/665
* Add contour lines shader & Hotkeys by @TokisanGames in https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/pull/680
* Implement uniform groups by @Xtarsia in https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/pull/761
* Add Generated CSharp Bindings. by @Sythelux in https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/pull/686
* Convert instancer MMIs from nodes to RS only by @aidandavey in https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/pull/722
* Add Ao packed normals by @Xtarsia in https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/pull/868
* Texture height vertex displacement and mesh tessellation by @Xtarsia in https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/pull/747
* Improve Region Blend, gizmos, shaders by @Xtarsia in https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/pull/899
* Add ocean mesh by @aidandavey in https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/pull/887
* Add example ocean shader by @TokisanGames in https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/pull/982
* Let Terrain3DMaterial limit the number of regions rendered by @TokisanGames in https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/pull/1003
* Add Slope colorizer by @TokisanGames in https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/pull/1021
* Option to use compressed color map by @stan4dbunny in https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/pull/842

Major UI improvements including:
* Highlight selected MMI on select in asset dock by @aidandavey in https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/pull/736
* Add foliage instance counter to asset dock as noted in #43 by @aidandavey in https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/pull/738
* Add search box to Asset Dock by @aidandavey in https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/pull/792
* Add Live Info Panel to Asset Dock by @aidandavey in https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/pull/1002
* Add multiselect to asset dock by @aidandavey in https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/pull/739

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/compare/v1.0.2-stable...v1.1.0-stable

Thanks to all our contributors to this version:

detail.readme:
![Terrain3D Logo](/doc/docs/images/terrain3d.jpg)

# Terrain3D
A high performance, editable terrain system for Godot 4.


## Features
* Written in C++ as a GDExtension addon, which works with official builds of Godot Engine
* [Can be accessed](https://terrain3d.readthedocs.io/en/stable/docs/programming_languages.html) by GDScript, C#, and any language Godot supports
* Terrains as small as 64x64m up to 65.5x65.5km (4295km^2) in non-contiguous and variable sized regions
* Up to 32 textures
* Up to 10 levels of detail for the terrain mesh
* Foliage instancing, with up to 10 levels of detail, and a shadow impostor
* Sculpting, holes, texture painting, texture detiling, painting colors and wetness
* Imports heightmaps from [HTerrain](https://github.com/Zylann/godot_heightmap_plugin/), Gaea, World Creator, World Machine, Unity, Unreal and any tool that can export a heightmap. See [heightmaps](https://terrain3d.readthedocs.io/en/stable/docs/heightmaps.html)


## Games Using Terrain3D

Please see the [featured games using Terrain3D](https://terrain3d.readthedocs.io/en/latest/docs/games.html) for examples of what it can do.


## Getting Started

1. Read the [Introduction](https://terrain3d.readthedocs.io/en/stable/docs/introduction.html) to understand how this terrain system works.

2. Read the [Installation & Upgrade](https://terrain3d.readthedocs.io/en/stable/docs/installation.html) instructions.

3. Watch the [tutorial videos](https://terrain3d.readthedocs.io/en/stable/docs/tutorial_videos.html) and read through the documentation.

4. For support, read [Getting Help](https://terrain3d.readthedocs.io/en/stable/docs/getting_help.html) and join our [Discord server](https://tokisan.com/discord).


## News & Updates
